reviewed_exceptions.reason: Generic operator account paths are deliberate negative fixtures in assertPrivacyClassifier; these are not actual account paths or personal data and protect static export privacy.
The literal .tools/.secrets/key is a generic negative classifier fixture required to reject private paths; no controller implementation or secret is exported.
TypeScript private controller is the product AbortController field used to interrupt trace playback. It is not a private maintainer controller reference.

scope: Exact current sanitized source snapshot; no Git, reachable history, remote refs, dependency advisory lookup, OCR, or pixel-content automation.
limitations: Pattern scanning is a bounded disclosure check, not a guarantee that every credential or private datum was detected.
Media approval is a supplied human inspection/capture record bound to exact bytes; this tool cannot infer pixel privacy.
Binary ASCII strings are pattern-scanned; encoded metadata, visual text, and other opaque representations may remain undetected.
Archive notices are detected by filename; redistribution correctness still needs review of the retained notices.
Explicit generated verification roots are outside the source export and must not be copied into publication.
The self manifest is excluded from its own content fingerprint and is not a payload or execution proof.
